# netmaker_nodes (Data Source)

Lists Netmaker nodes, optionally filtered to a single network.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `network` (String) If set, only list nodes in this network; otherwise list nodes across all networks.

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `address6` (String)
- `connected` (Boolean)
- `device_id` (String) ID of the Device this node belongs to.
- `id` (String)
- `is_egress_gateway` (Boolean)
- `is_ingress_gateway` (Boolean)
- `is_internet_gateway` (Boolean)
- `is_relay` (Boolean)
- `network` (String)
- `status` (String)
